description: Analog chorus modelled on the Juno circuit through a guitar pedal version of it, using four bucket brigade delay lines, with a modulation rate control the original did not have

params.text: Sets the dry to wet balance and the depth of the modulation together, from no effect to full chorus
Moves between the two modulation signals of the original circuit, from mode I through I+II to mode II
Sets the speed of the modulation signals
Attenuates and inverts the I-II input before it is added to the I-II knob
Attenuates and inverts the DEPTH input before it is added to the DEPTH knob
Attenuates and inverts the RATE input before it is added to the RATE knob

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio input
The right channel of the audio input, and when it is unpatched the left channel feeds both
A control voltage added to the I-II setting, scaled by the I-II attenuverter
A control voltage added to the DEPTH setting, scaled by the DEPTH attenuverter
A control voltage added to the RATE setting, scaled by the RATE attenuverter

outputs.text: The left channel of the chorused signal
The right channel of the chorused signal
